label: Primary Source
description: Direct primary-source material such as legislation, regulator publications or official records.

label: Documentary Evidence
description: Project-held documentary material such as authored governance records, correspondence or file-controlled documentation.

label: Practitioner Declared
description: A practitioner statement or owner declaration that still requires appropriate corroboration where needed.

label: Photo Supported
description: Supported in part by photographic records, without implying full independent verification.

label: Professional Reviewed
description: A category reserved for material that has later received documented professional review; no current record is implied to have this status.

label: External Source
description: Supported by an external source that is not itself primary or direct documentary evidence.

label: System Derived
description: Derived from controlled internal systems or register logic and still dependent on underlying evidence quality.

label: Unknown
description: Evidence basis not yet clearly recorded.

label: Unable to Verify
description: No adequate evidence basis has yet been established.
